claims.locator: 42524 enzyme assay Methods;42527 deglycase Results;42528 Fig8 caption
claims.claim: Mg salts present; ATP-Mg supplied to FrlD. NADH/NADP and PEP serve coupled reporter systems.
claims.qualifier: No metal-removal/reconstitution experiment establishes indispensable Mg cofactor. ZnCl2 at10µM completely suppresses FrlB activity; EGTA/EDTA stimulate, and0.1mM EGTA is included in later assays. Zinc-specific buffer is not separately fully restated.

claims.claim: Fructoselysine supports growth and induction of kinase/deglycase activities.
claims.qualifier: BL21(DE3)pLysS, M9,20mM substrate; no knockout/rescue experiment in this paper.
